info.background_text:
The galaxy's #1 idol, and the brightest shining star
The top idol in the galaxy. Her bright smile and boundless energy have won the hearts of countless fans. Anyone who has witnessed Tenebria's performance is instantly captivated by her extraordinary vocal talent and overwhelming stage presence. There's simply no escaping it.
